problem_statement: When a CoAP GET request omits Block2 and a resource initiates a blockwise response with a smaller supported block size, the server advertises the maximum block size instead. Clients can then misinterpret the response and fail to continue the transfer. Advertise the smaller block size in the serialized reply and limit the payload to that block. Preserve the response token, confirmable and non-confirmable request correlation, client-selected Block2 behavior, ordinary non-blockwise responses, and final-block signaling.
